resolved.title: ES6 Map
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]ES6 Map[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]Map[/b] object can be used to hold [b]key/value[/b] pairs. A key or value in a map can be anything (objects and primitive values). 

The syntax [b]new Map([iterable])[/b] creates a Map object where [b]iterable [/b]is an array or any other iterable object whose elements are arrays (with a key/value pair each).

An [b]Object [/b]is similar to [b]Map [/b]but there are important differences that make using a Map preferable in certain cases:
1) The keys can be any type including functions, objects, and any primitive.
2) You can get the size of a Map.
3) You can directly iterate over Map.
4) Performance of the Map is better in scenarios involving frequent addition and removal of key/value pairs.

The [b]size [/b]property returns the number of key/value pairs in a map.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="1610"]let map = new [b]Map[/b]([['k1', 'v1'], ['k2', 'v2']]);

console.log(map.size); // 2[/code]
[b]Methods[/b]
[b]set(key, value)[/b] Adds a specified key/value pair to the map. If the specified key already exists, value corresponding to it is replaced with the specified value.
[b]get(key)[/b] Gets the value corresponding to a specified key in the map. If the specified key doesn't exist, undefined is returned.
[b]has(key)[/b] Returns true if a specified key exists in the map and false otherwise.
[b]delete(key)[/b] Deletes the key/value pair with a specified key from the map and returns true. Returns false if the element does not exist.
[b]clear()[/b] Removes all key/value pairs from map.
[b]keys()[/b] Returns an Iterator of keys in the map for each element.
[b]values()[/b] Returns an Iterator of values in the map for each element.
[b]entries()[/b] Returns an Iterator of array[key, value] in the map for each element.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="1611"]let map = new Map();

map.[b]set[/b]('k1', 'v1').[b]set[/b]('k2', 'v2');

console.log(map.[b]get[/b]('k1')); // v1

console.log(map.[b]has[/b]('k2')); // true

for (let kv of map.[b]entries[/b]())
  console.log(kv[0] + " : " + kv[1]);[/code]
The above example demonstrates some of the ES6 Map methods.
[note][b]Map[/b] supports different data types i.e. 1 and "1" are two different keys/values.[/note]

content.text:
A **Map** object can be used to hold **key/value** pairs. A key or value in a map can be anything (objects and primitive values). 

The syntax **new Map([iterable])** creates a Map object where **iterable **is an array or any other iterable object whose elements are arrays (with a key/value pair each).

一个 **Map** 对象可以用来保存 **键/值** 对。Map 中的键或值可以是任何东西（对象和原始值）。

使用语法 **new Map([iterable])** 创建一个 Map 对象，其中 **iterable** 是一个数组或任何其他的可迭代对象，其元素是数组（每个元素有一个键/值对）。

一个**对象**类似于 **Map**，但有一些重要的区别，使得在某些情况下使用 Map 更为可取。
1）键可以是任何类型，包括函数、对象和任何原始类似的值。
2) 你可以获取一个 Map 的大小。
3) 你可以直接对 Map 进行遍历。
4) 在涉及频繁添加和删除键/值对的情况下，Map 的性能更好。

**size** 属性返回 Map 中键/值对的数量。

**方法**
**set(key, value)** 在 Map 中添加一个键/值对。如果指定的键已经存在，与之对应的值将被替换成指定的值。

**entries()** 返回 Map 中每个元素的数组[key, value]迭代器。

resolved.title: 员工信息管理
resolved.problem_statement_md:
在给给的程序中，某公司的五名员工存储在Map中。
他们的名字被设置为键，职位设置为值。
现在该公司正在招聘一名新员工，程序输入新员工的名字和职位，并需要把它们存储在现有的Map中。

请完善程序，按示例格式向控制台输出所有员工信息。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]ES6 Map[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Five employees at a company are stored in Map in the program you are given. Their names are set as keys and their positions as values. The company is hiring one more employee. The program should take the name and the position as inputs and store them in the existing map.
Complete the program to perform that operation and output to the console the list of employees in the format shown in the sample output.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
Bob
Developer

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Richard : Developer
Maria : SEO Specialist
Tom : Product Manager
David : Accountant
Sophia : HR Manager
Bob : Developer

[note]The [b]entries()[/b] method returns an Iterator of array[key, value] in the map for each element.
Don't forget to put spaces before and after the colon (:) in the output.

[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
**entries**()方法为每个元素返回map中数组[key, value]的一个Iterator。
不要忘记在输出中的冒号（:）前后加上空格。

testcases.expected_output:
Richard : Developer
Maria : SEO Specialist
Tom : Product Manager
David : Accountant
Sophia : HR Manager
Robert : Developer

resolved.title: ES6 Set
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]ES6 Set[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]Set[/b] object can be used to hold [b]unique [/b]values (no repetitions are allowed).
A value in a set can be anything (objects and primitive values). 

The syntax [b]new Set([iterable])[/b] creates a Set object where [b]iterable [/b]is an array or any other iterable object of values.

The [b]size [/b]property returns the number of distinct values in a set.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="4909"]let set = new [b]Set[/b]([1, 2, 4, 2, 59, 9, 4, 9, 1]);

console.log(set.size); // 5[/code]
[b]Methods[/b]
[b]add(value)[/b] Adds a new element with the given value to the Set.
[b]delete(value)[/b] Deletes a specified value from the set.
[b]has(value)[/b] Returns true if a specified value exists in the set and false otherwise.
[b]clear()[/b] Clears the set.
[b]values()[/b] Returns an Iterator of values in the set.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="4908"]let set = new Set();

set.[b]add[/b](5).[b]add[/b](9).[b]add[/b](59).[b]add[/b](9);

console.log(set.[b]has[/b](9));

for (let v of set.[b]values[/b]())
  console.log(v);[/code]
The above example demonstrates some of the ES6 Set methods.
[note][b]Set[/b] supports different data types i.e. [b]1[/b] and [b]"1" [/b]are two different values.
NaN and undefined can also be stored in Set.[/note]
